name: Certificate of Achievement (COA) Italian Language and Culture
program_text: program 11 ITAL - Italian Italian Language and Culture COA_Italian Language and Culture Go Back Print Certificate of Achievement (COA) Italian Language and Culture New Online Option Noncredit New for Spring 2026 Program Description Pending state approval. Please check with the CTE Division Office for status. The Certificate of Achievement in Italian Language and Culture offers opportunities to appreciate the Italian language and culture, as well as dig into the interconnections between Italian culture, Latin American culture and Italian American culture. Italian is an excellent major or minor for those who plan to pursue graduate work in areas such as philosophy, anthropology, history, linguistics or business. Understanding the diversity of cultural, historical and social contexts in the Italian-speaking world will provide new insights and a critical lens. The certificate will enhance the multicultural education that De Anza aims to foster and will open additional opportunities for students who plan to study abroad. Program Learning Outcomes Upon completion, students will be able to Engage in communicative tasks that require describing personal experiences in the present with some references to the past; expressing basic opinions about abstract topics; understanding main ideas and supporting textual details; producing discourse level writing related to personal experiences Demonstrate an understanding of the diversity of cultural, historical, and regional contexts of Italian-speaking peoples and cultures Engage critically with constructions of cultural and social differences (as expressed through language) while examining one´s own cultural positioning and assumptions De Anza College Requirements Noncredit Certificate Requirements Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a C grade, passing grade or satisfactory progress Each course must be completed at De Anza College Skills Certificate Requirements Skills Certificates are awarded by departments and are not notated on official college transcripts. Contact the department directly for assistance in applying for a skills certificate. Completion of all major courses with a C grade or higher Each course must be completed at De Anza College Certificate of Achievement Requirements Certificates of Achievement are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. No more than six quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements Certificates of Achievement-Advanced are awarded by the college and notated on official transcripts. Each course listed as a program requirement must be completed with a letter grade of C or higher. Pass/No Pass grades are not accepted for these courses. Students must demonstrate proficiency in English and Mathematics by qualifying for ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H or ESL 5, and by qualifying for MATH 114 or a transfer-level Math course No more than 18 quarter units may be transferred from other academic institutions Cal-GETC Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements See Cal-GETC pattern found at deanza.edu/articulation/ge-requirements . Note: This is an exception to the Certificate of Achievement-Advanced Requirements. The requirements are stated within the description. Associate Degrees (A.A. or A.S.) Requirements Proficiencies Students must demonstrate proficiency in reading, written expression and mathematics. Total Units Students must complete at least 90 degree-applicable quarter units, including required major courses and GE courses At least 24 of those 90 units must be completed at De Anza College All De Anza courses must be completed with a minimum GPA of 2.0 All 90 degree units, including courses transferred from other institutions, must be completed with a minimum GPA of 2.0 General Education Studen
